## Datasets

New datasets may be tracked from asset inventories, program announcements, and press releases.

## Applications

Applications may be found on data catalogs as external tool, code repositories, or web pages that provide context of their purpose.

## Map Applications

Maps, map applications, and hub sites developed on ArcGIS Online may be found in data catalogs.

## Data Narratives and Visualizations

Data stories created by departments that show current conditions and the results of program actions

## Initiative Web Sites

Websites created to provide narrative and data.
